messages:
Sam: morning async — quick check-in (api gateway / routing / auth / rate limits)

Sam: what I did: landed header-based canary for routing (x-rw-tenant), added cookie fallback tests.
Sam: blockers: seeing ~0.2% 429s in the synthetic burst test; looks like batching config + throttling interaction.
Sam: today: finish rollout, push adaptive throttling params, and open PR for token refresh fix.

Jia: saw the canary metrics — looks healthy overall. quick q: are we routing on `x-rw-tenant` header or `tenant-id`? tests had both.

Sam: using `x-rw-tenant` now. updated docs in gateway-config repo, PR #412 (https://git/repo/eng/gateway-config/pull/412).

Omar: noticed a few 401s during the canary. repro snippet:
```
curl -v -H 'x-rw-tenant: acme' 'https://staging-api.redwood.test/route' 
# sometimes returns 401 when token refresh race happens
```

Sam: thanks — those are likely short-lived token expirations during long polling. I'll patch the proxy token refresh flow and open issue #784.

Leo: blocker for me: I need the rate-limit header schema change merged before I update Alertmanager rules. pinging @sam for the merge.

Sam: @Leo merging in ~10m. FYI bumped burst window to 50 for bursts under 1s to smooth test spikes.

Anya: deployed a small test to staging: `curl -H 'x-rw-tenant: acme' https://staging-api.redwood.test/ping` -> 200s. p50 45ms, p95 220ms. logs show a couple cache misses on prefix keys.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: deploy completed to staging at 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z :rocket:

Jia: code review ping @Sam on PR #412 — left a couple nits about test coverage. also can we add a smokecheck in eng-runtime to catch token expiry regressions?

Sam: ack — adding a smokecheck task to the board and will add two unit tests to cover the token refresh race.

Omar: happy to pair with Sam on the token refresh tomorrow morning. also FYI the gw returns rate headers as `x-rw-ratelimit-remaining` and `x-rw-ratelimit-reset`.

Leo: heads up: apigw-config change will need a short migration script for existing routes. i'll open a follow-up PR after schema merge.

Anya: :thumbsup: i'll run a higher-qps eval against the canary later today and post the results here.

Sam: thanks all. if 429s spike, fallback policy -> model-small. will post update after merging PRs and the token fix.
